svg.title: Runoff grid to catchment inflow
svg.desc: High-resolution pixels assign their area to the runoff cell that contains them and the catchment they belong to. The overlap areas form a sparse matrix W with one row per catchment; on each GPU a runoff chunk R is multiplied by W transposed to give catchment inflow Q in one sparse-dense product.
svg.text: Overlap areas become a sparse matrix, applied on the GPU in one product
Each hi-res pixel adds its area
to W[c, g] for catchment c and cell g.
columns runoff cells, g = iy·nlon + ix
values overlap area, m², not normalized
T steps · G active cells · C catchments
